title: Az Ellenzéki Kerekasztal és a békés átmenet (Opposition Roundtable & Negotiated Transition)
grammar: Constitutional Proclamations, Negotiated Democracy & Sovereign Historical Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Opposition Roundtable and the National Roundtable were.
I can say where and when the MDF was formed.
I can say what the sides agreed, using megállapodtak, hogy and a verb in the subjunctive.
I can say in the past tense that the negotiating partners reached common ground.
